auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: One account to enter tournaments, book lessons, shop and follow your progress.
auth.phoneHelp: You will receive a 6-digit code by SMS. Beninese numbers can be typed without +229.
auth.emailHelp: You will receive a 6-digit code by e-mail.
auth.newAccount: No account yet? One is created automatically the first time you sign in. By continuing you accept the terms of use and privacy policy.
auth.sendError: Could not send the code. Please try again.
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
auth.oauthError: Google sign-in failed. Try again or use your phone.

errors.terms_required: You must accept the terms of use.
errors.child_must_be_minor: Family accounts are for children under 18.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.profile_incomplete: Incomplete profile: birth date and sex are required.
errors.conditions_not_met: This player does not meet the entry conditions.
errors.payment_unavailable: Online payment is temporarily unavailable. Choose payment on site.
errors.invalid_payment_method: Payment method not available for this tournament.

profile.title: My profile
profile.welcomeText: A few details to create your player profile. They are used for age categories, rankings and registrations.
profile.fideHint: Your FIDE rating will be imported every month.
profile.consentTerms: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy (required).
profile.consentPublic: Show my profile in the public directory and rankings.
profile.consentImage: I allow photos of me to be published (image rights).
profile.consentImageChild: I allow photos of my child to be published.
profile.parentalText: By creating this profile you confirm you are the child's parent or legal guardian and accept the terms on their behalf. A minor's public profile stays limited, without photo.

account.ratingsNote: Ratings are updated after each rated tournament.

family.title: Family account
family.intro: Create and manage your children's profiles: you can register them for tournaments and lessons from your account.

data.title: My data
data.intro: View, correct, export or delete your personal data, in line with Benin's Digital Code.
data.exportText: Download all your data (profile, registrations, payments, ratings) as JSON.
data.deleteText: Your request will be processed within 30 days. Tournament results and games are kept as sporting archives, anonymised on request.
data.deletePending: Your deletion request is being processed.

ticket.qrLabel: Ticket QR code, to show at check-in
ticket.help: Show this QR code at the desk on tournament day (on your phone or printed).

registration.title: Registration
registration.closed: Registration is not open for this tournament.
registration.addChild: Registering a child? Add them to your family account

methodHelp.online: MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Celtiis Cash or bank card, through our secure provider.
methodHelp.on_site: Your place is reserved; pay at the desk on tournament day.

registration.feeTbcHelp: The fee is not set yet: it will be paid on site.

payment.fakeText: Development test provider: no money is taken. Choose the outcome to simulate.

statusText.unknown: Check your registrations in your account.

admin.title: Administration
admin.mfaIntro: Administration accounts are protected by a second factor: a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password…).
admin.mfaEnroll: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code shown.
admin.mfaVerify: Enter the code shown in your authenticator app.
admin.standingsHelp: Import a CSV file or paste a table (columns: rank, name, points, optionally rating, club, fide_id, phone). Unknown players get a pre-created profile they can claim with their phone number.
admin.pgnHelp: Upload one or more PGN files (one round or the whole event). Each game is validated then linked to players by name.
admin.pgnImported: {imported} games imported, {linked} linked to both players, {rejected} rejected.
